generalAbilities.name: Web Sense
generalAbilities.description:
The spider swarm has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

See rules...

Tremorsense allows a monster to feel the vibrations through a solid surface caused by movement. It is an imprecise sense with a limited range (listed in the ability). Tremorsense functions only if the monster is on the same surface as the subject, and only if the subject is moving along (or burrowing through) the surface.

defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spider Swarm Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 14 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 1 Poison Damage and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 1d4 Poison Damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarming Bites
offensiveAbilities.description:
Each enemy in the spider swarm's space takes 1d4 Piercing Damage damage with a Basic DC 14 Reflex Saving Throw save.

A creature that fails its save is exposed to spider swarm venom.
